items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: And after that, I joined Zack Whyte.

ctx.x: Joe and Roy, and then Teddy and Gus. Gus played trombone, and he was a very great arranger. He was a good trombone player, too, but he was an excellent arranger.
And after that, I joined Zack Whyte.
Were these bands mostly working around the Midwest?

items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: So I met Zach Whyte, and joined him. And we came here to New York with Zack, and played the Savoy.

ctx.x: So I met Zach Whyte, and joined him. And we came here to New York with Zack, and played the Savoy. And that's when I made my first record that they released. But I never got any...what do they call it...? No mentions on it. But I sang it. It was with Luis Russell, and it was a piece of...oh, I'm trying to... Nesbitt!
